cost_protocol.final_owner_rule: consumer-sts-(partition modulo 3), four hot and sixteen cold partitions per consumer
cost_protocol.processing_interruption: Last completion before resume_requested to first processing_start after resume_requested, with no recorded processing interval intersecting that gap; also report the no-completion gap and each process released-to-resumed duration.
cost_protocol.transition_interval: release_requested through active_verified; report scheduled request, actual decision and resume timestamps separately
cost_protocol.outstanding_work: Count distinct successfully acknowledged messages whose acknowledgment callback timestamp is at or before t and whose completion timestamp is after t. Include warm-up. This is event-derived acknowledged-but-unfinished work, not exact broker lag.
cost_protocol.accumulation: Report outstanding work at release request and active verification and their net difference, plus growth during the observed processing interruption. Do not call the net change a causal counterfactual cost.

recovery.report: First low-backlog observation and later confirmation; require consecutive valid same-owner monotonic-offset observations. Mark not observed if the criterion is not met before production stops. Do not extend production or change thresholds after seeing results.

other_measurements: requested consumer CPU and memory integrated over evaluation plus drain
evidence: consumer processing start and completion timestamps
cost_protocol.failure_rules: Stop on preparation, ownership, identity or handoff failure. Retain unfavorable valid performance outcomes. No extra performance trials automatically. Technical validation is separate from the four-trial count. Restore original configuration and three stopped consumers.
